monitored_text: CNC Drilling For ABS Plastic ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene) plastic is a kind of versatile thermoplastic plastic of low cost, used for making functional and large parts with good mechanical properties. As ABS provides a balanced combination of chemical resistance, mechanical toughness, wide temperature ranges, as well as easy processing, stable product size and good surface luster, it is ideal for turning, drilling and milling. ABS plastic in CNC drilling is usually by hammering a drill bit into the hole with quickly repeated short movement. The hammering action can be performed from outside the hole or within the hole. After surface treatment of silk-screen printing, anodizing, electroplating, powder coating, etc, you can get the final CNC drilling ABS parts . Since ABS is easy to machine and fabricate, it is widely used for machining preproduction prototypes simply because of its excellent dimensional stability.
